rule: Site heat assessment and programme, acclimatisation, communication, water, rest, first aid and records required.
Assess environmental conditions and compare against TWL process to select controls.
TWL assumes hydrated, acclimatised, self-paced workers; measured environmental inputs required. No computation is performed in this demo.
Outdoor work prohibited 12:30–15:00 from 15 June through 15 September in this demo; no exemption claimed.
Hold exposed heavy work in the affected zone at TWL <=150 W/m²; this is an invented Sandline trigger, not a regulatory zone threshold.
TWL older than 5 minutes or failed sensor cannot clear affected zone work; other zones are not substitutes.
Escalate unacknowledged hold to superintendent after 2 minutes.
No automatic restart; supervisor checks fresh local measurement, people, water, rest, permit and midday rule before authorisation.
Suspected heat illness prompts immediate access to trained medical attention and incident reporting irrespective of TWL.
